notes: PROC UNIVARIATE on sashelp.class(name,age) with nextrobs=5, id name — the repo's demonstration. Applies the repo's `ods exclude where=(_path_ ? 'Univariate')` statement, captures the Extreme Observations table via `ods output extremeobs=want`, and prints it. Data is the built-in sashelp.class, so nothing is sampled or rewritten; the only adaptation from the commentary block is a `proc print data=want` so the captured dataset is visible, and the ExtremeObs capture is taken generically.
